label: For arbitrary worlds, individuals, Kripke frames, bearers and evaluation worlds, the stipulated…
paraphrase: For arbitrary worlds, individuals, Kripke frames, bearers and evaluation worlds, the stipulated filtered Scott-style necessary-existence predicate becomes logically equivalent to the original Scott/AFP NE when all intensional properties are admitted in both property quantifiers. This checks that the filtered variant preserves the original definitions at the unrestricted endpoint; it does not justify any alternative property domain.
